title: Health Screenings for Those from Countries with High-risk of Nipah Virus, and Healthcare Advisories to Doctors and Public
what_it_is: Health Screenings for Those from Countries with High-risk of Nipah Virus, and Healthcare Advisories to Doctors and Public

sections.label: Health measures for travellers and workers
sections.summary: Clinical guidance, a webinar, an adjusted Health Declaration Card, temperature screening and CDA announcements to migrant workers and employers were issued, with CDA monitoring India and globally.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Since then, we have further issued clinical guidance to all medical practitioners, conducted an educational webinar for primary care doctors, adjusted the electronic Health Declaration Card for all incoming travellers and activated temperature screening for travellers arriving on ships from affected areas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower has also disseminated CDA’s announcements on precautionary health measures to migrant workers and migrant domestic workers as well as to employers, dormitory operators and employment agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: CDA is monitoring the situation in India and globally closely, and will adjust our measures as needed based on the evolving risks that are developing.

sections.label: Enhanced SG Arrival Card prompts
sections.summary: The enhanced electronic health declaration card prompts travellers who click yes to symptoms to enter their previous travel destination, including West Bengal.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Indeed, the answer to her question is yes, we have enhanced the electronic health declaration card, which is part of the SG Arrival Card.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In this format, if the arriving individual, clicks yes on the SG Arrival Card to any of the symptoms, then there will be a prompt to enter the previous travel destination, and that would include the West Bengal region as well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But if the person clicks no to any of the symptoms, then he would not be prompted for any travel destinations that we are monitoring.

sections.label: SG Arrival Card data to CDA
sections.summary: Information collected by the SG Arrival declaration card is piped into CDA for contact tracing if necessary.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Any of the information collected by the SG Arrival declaration card will indeed be piped into CDA so that we can perform any contact tracing if necessary.
